fusions.name: Gutter Contagion
fusions.desc: Flicks a filthy tine that deals 4 damage and has a 25% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Scurrying Horde
fusions.desc: A mob pours out around you, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Hold-Fast Pack
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 14 seconds that gnaws an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Off the Ship
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
